title: Cross Site Request Forgery protections are improperly configured in jspwiki.war in Apache JSPWIKI 3.0.0 on all…
description: Apache JSPWIKI 3.0.0 contains a vulnerability where Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protections are improperly configured, allowing attackers to bypass these protections. A workaround exists for current deployments, and upgrading to version 3.0.1 resolves the issue.
